Coram : M.R. SHAH*, A.S. BOPANNA
COURT REPORTS [2023] 3 S.C.R. COMMISSIONER OF INCOME TAX 7 v. M/S PAVILLE PROJECTS PVT. LTD. (Civil Appeal No. 6126 of 2021) APRIL 06, 2023 [M. R. SHAH AND A. S. BOPANNA JJ.] Income Tax Act, 1961 – s.263 – Exercise of jurisdiction under – Respondent filed its income tax return sale proceeds to pay off the shareholders and therefore, the said discharge of encumbrances was “cost of improvement” – Assessment accepted by AO u/s. 143(3) – However, the Commissioner invoked jurisdiction u/s. 263 of the IT Act and held that the assessment order passed
Decision Date : 06-04-2023 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 6126/2021 | Disposal Nature : Appeal(s) allowed | Bench : 2 Judges
